Rift 0.11.1 fixes a crash when stopping or closing the disk usage scanner while a scan is in progress.

## Download

- **`Rift-win-Setup.exe`**: installs Rift for your user (no admin rights, no .NET needed). Already have 0.9–0.11.0? It updates itself.
- **`Rift-win-Portable.zip`**: runs from any folder, no install, and updates itself too.

The exe isn't signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn on the first start: "More info" → "Run anyway".

## Fixed in 0.11.1

- Fixed a native `dcomp.dll` (`0xE0464645`) crash when stopping or closing the disk usage overlay mid-scan by switching Avalonia's Win32 composition mode from `DirectComposition` to `RedirectionSurface` (keeping ANGLE D3D11 GPU rendering without `DirectCompositionConnection`'s thread-safety race)
- Hardened the disk usage scanner overlay: cached immutable theme brushes, coalesced UI progress updates, stopped the indeterminate progress animation immediately on Stop/Close, and deferred `CancellationTokenSource` disposal to the scanner worker

See [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/keyldev/rift/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) for what's next.
